import json
from ghidra.program.disassemble import Disassembler
from ghidra.program.model.address import AddressSet
p=currentProgram
a=p.getAddressFactory()
f=p.getFunctionManager()
rows=[]
for start,size,entries in [["140620470",2636,["1406204c2","1406207ff","1406205f1","14062064d","1406204dc","140620864","14062091c","14062079e","140620b57","140620561"]],["140df3e70",431,["140df3e93","140df3f8e","140df3ec2","140df3f74","140df3eb4"]],["1421bb740",564,["1421bb770","1421bb88b","1421bb784","1421bb871","1421bb897","1421bb959"]]]:
    begin=a.getAddress(start)
    body=AddressSet(begin,begin.add(size-1))
    fn=f.getFunctionAt(begin)
    overlaps=[str(x.getEntryPoint()) for x in f.getFunctionsOverlapping(body) if x!=fn]
    if overlaps: raise ValueError('Overlapping author ranges '+str(overlaps))
    tx=p.startTransaction('Original RNE jump-table bounded bodies')
    ok=False
    try:
        for e in entries:
            Disassembler.getDisassembler(p,monitor,None).disassemble(a.getAddress(e),body,True)
        fn.setBody(body)
        ok=True
        rows.append({'address':start,'body_bytes':size,'branch_entries':entries})
    finally:p.endTransaction(tx,ok)
print(json.dumps(rows))
